description:
What this is. Every scan at a machine lands here as one row: who scanned, when, and whether it was on the way in or out. Attendance is worked out from these.

What to do. Open the list and check today has rows. If scans have stopped, this is the first place it shows — and it usually means the machines are no longer being reached.

Where to find it. Employee Checkin in the menu on the left.
name: Check Employee Checkins
title: Employee Checkin — the scans as they arrive
